subject: Film & Cinema
title: Costume as Character
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Costume as Character.

hook.text: Indiana Jones' hat, Darth Vader's helmet, Holly Golightly's black dress — costume is identity.

buildup.text: Costume designers communicate status, personality, era, and transformation through clothing.

discovery.text: In The Devil Wears Prada, Andy's wardrobe evolution tracks her moral transformation visually.

twist.text: Audiences rarely think about costumes consciously — but remove them and the character collapses.

climax.text: Great costume design makes you understand a character before they speak a word.

punchline.text: Clothes don't make the person. They make the character.

quiz.question: How do costumes function in visual storytelling?
options: They communicate status, personality, and character transformation
